definitions.explanation: The part that follows; what comes next in a series or story.

examples.japanese: {続|つづ}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦{話|はな}します→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: I'll tell you the rest tomorrow.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{続|つづ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}たい→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I want to see the sequel to this movie.
When will the continuation of this book come out?

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧{続|つづ}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乾|かわ}かない→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧。
examples.english: The laundry won't dry because of the continuous rain.
examples.notes: 〜{続|つづ}き = a series of ~, continuous ~

examples.japanese: ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧{続|つづ}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{自信|じしん}→自信：10143_jishin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦なくして→無くす：01110_nakusu⟧⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: After a series of failures, I lost my confidence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧{続|つづ}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧。
examples.english: Good things keep happening lately, and every day is fun.

notes:
The noun form of ⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (to continue). Has two main uses: (1) the continuation or sequel of something, and (2) a suffix meaning a series or succession of things.

SENSE 1 — CONTINUATION:
- {続|つづ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧/⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to read/watch the continuation
- {続|つづ}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧: the rest is tomorrow (to be continued)
- {続|つづ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気|き}になる→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧: to be curious about what happens next
- {続|つづ}きもの: serial, ongoing series

SENSE 2 — 〜{続|つづ}き SUFFIX:
Attached to nouns to mean "a series of ~" or "continuous ~":
- ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧{続|つづ}き: continuous rain
- ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧{続|つづ}き: a series of failures
- ⟦{不運|ふうん}→不運：00049_fuun⟧{続|つづ}き: a string of bad luck
- ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧こと{続|つづ}き: a run of good things
